verdict.rationale: Kong documents load balancing across multiple LLM models behind a provider-agnostic API, routing that can adapt to various metrics, and semantic-similarity routing. Together these let a gateway policy redirect an agent's requests to different models without client changes. missing for 10: explicit documentation of availability-based failover/fallback between models, explicit cost-based routing rules (cost is only tracked and budgeted), clear capability-based model selection beyond semantic routing, and independent or hands-on corroboration of mid-task switching.
